scene: one plain plate on a plain table, front view at table height, a child's face in profile leaning in from the left. On the plate sits a slice of cake, and a small open bowl of sugar cubes stands beside the plate. The child licks the lips with the tip of the tongue, eyes on the cake. No heart.
must: a slice of cake beside a bowl of sugar cubes, the child licking the lips.
avoid: a child puckering the lips at a cut lemon (zuur); a child smiling with a floating heart (lekker); a pepper with flames (heet); a child crying beside the cake (verdrietig).
contrast: Pair with zuur. The only difference is the food and the face: cake with sugar cubes and lip-licking here, a cut lemon and a puckered mouth there.
example_nl: De taart is heel zoet.
example_en: The cake is very sweet.
alt: Een kind likt zijn lippen af bij een stuk taart; naast het bord staat een schaaltje suikerklontjes.

scene: one plain plate on a plain table, front view at table height, a child's face in profile leaning in from the left. On the plate sits a half lemon with a wedge cut out and a few drops spraying from it. The child's eyes are squeezed shut, the nose wrinkled, the lips pulled into a tight pucker and the cheeks sucked in.
must: a child with a scrunched face and puckered lips facing a cut lemon.
avoid: a child licking the lips at a slice of cake (zoet); a child with a tongue out in disgust at a rotten apple (vies); a child crying (verdrietig); a bitter coffee cup with steam (bitter).
contrast: Pair with zoet. The only difference is the food and the face: a cut lemon and a puckered mouth here, cake with sugar cubes and lip-licking there.
example_nl: Deze citroen is erg zuur.
example_en: This lemon is very sour.
alt: Een kind knijpt de ogen dicht en trekt de lippen samen voor een halve citroen.

scene: one plain wooden stick lies across the full width of the page on a plain flat ground line, side view, both ends touching two small stones. The stick lies perfectly level, and a thin straight guide line is drawn just above it, parallel and equal in length, so no part of the stick bends away.
must: a stick lying dead level beside a parallel straight guide line.
avoid: a stick with one smooth arc (krom); a leaning stick (scheef); a stick tilted upward at one end (schuin); a short stick (kort).
contrast: Pair with krom. The only difference is the shape of the stick: perfectly straight here, one smooth arc there.
example_nl: Teken een rechte lijn op het papier.
example_en: Draw a straight line on the paper.
alt: Een lange stok ligt waterpas tussen twee stenen, met een evenwijdige lijn erboven.

scene: one plain wooden stick lies across the full width of the page on a plain flat ground line, side view, both ends touching two small stones. The stick bends in one smooth arc in the middle, like a banana. A thin straight guide line above it shows how far the middle bends away, and a small gap shows under the middle.
must: a stick with a strong arc and a visible gap under its middle.
avoid: a perfectly level stick (recht); a stick leaning on one stone (scheef); a zigzag stick (not the card); a coiled rope (not the card).
contrast: Pair with recht. The only difference is the shape of the stick: one smooth arc here, perfectly straight there.
example_nl: De oude man loopt met een kromme rug.
example_en: The old man walks with a bent back.
alt: Een stok buigt in het midden als een boog tussen twee stenen.

scene: one adult hand, palm up, seen from the side against a plain background, holds one egg-sized pebble that is perfectly smooth: a clean even oval outline with no bumps, no cracks and no dots. Nothing else is in the picture.
must: a clean even oval stone with no bumps.
avoid: a stone covered in bumps and cracks (ruw); a round ball (not the card); a stone in water with drops (nat); a flat sheet of ice (not the card).
contrast: Pair with ruw. The only difference is the stone's surface: a clean even oval here, bumps and cracks there.
example_nl: De tafel is glad en schoon.
example_en: The table is smooth and clean.
alt: Een hand houdt een ovale steen zonder bulten, barsten of stippen.

scene: one adult hand, palm up, seen from the side against a plain background, holds one stone the size of an egg but with a jagged outline, many small bumps, short crack lines and scattered dots all over it, and tiny stone flakes lying on the palm.
must: a jagged stone with bumps, cracks and speckles and no shine.
avoid: a clean even oval stone (glad); a stone with moss (not the card); a sharp spike (scherp); a heavy boulder (zwaar).
contrast: Pair with glad. The only difference is the stone's surface: jagged with bumps and cracks here, a clean even oval there.
example_nl: De muur voelt ruw aan.
example_en: The wall feels rough.
alt: Een hand houdt een hoekige steen met bulten, barsten en stippen.

scene: SKIP: ripeness is carried by colour, which the cobalt-only style excludes; drawn by size it reads groot/klein (review 20 Nov 2026, H9).
must: a plump apple weighing a branch down, with another fallen below.
avoid: a small hard apple on a straight branch (onrijp); a rotten apple with spots and a worm (rot); a pear (not the set); a peeled apple (not the card)
contrast: Pair with onrijp. The only difference is the fruit's state: big, plump and weighing the branch down with one fallen below here, tiny and hard on a straight branch there.
example_nl: De appel is rijp en lekker.
example_en: The apple is ripe and tasty.
alt: Een grote ronde appel buigt een tak naar beneden en een tweede ligt op de grond.

scene: SKIP: ripeness is carried by colour, which the cobalt-only style excludes; drawn by size it reads groot/klein (review 20 Nov 2026, H9).
must: a tiny hard apple on a stiff straight branch with an empty ground.
avoid: a big plump apple on a bending branch (rijp); a rotten apple with spots (rot); a flower only with no fruit (not the card); a peeled apple (not the card)
contrast: Pair with rijp. The only difference is the fruit's state: tiny, hard and held on a stiff branch here, big and plump on a bending branch there.
example_nl: De bananen zijn nog onrijp.
example_en: The bananas are still unripe.
alt: Een kleine, harde appel zit vast aan een rechte tak boven lege grond.

scene: one child stands alone on a plain floor line facing the viewer, plain wall behind, with the shoulders pulled in, the head tilted down and the eyes looking sideways at the floor, one hand twisting the hem of the shirt and the other arm hiding behind the back. The mouth is small and closed and one foot turns inward.
must: a child with hunched shoulders, lowered head, and hands twisting the shirt.
avoid: a child with hands on hips and a wide grin (brutaal); a crying child (verdrietig); a child hiding fully behind a wall (bang); a sleeping child (slaperig).
contrast: Pair with brutaal. The only difference is the child's pose: shoulders in and head down here, chin up and hands on hips there.
example_nl: Mijn zusje is verlegen bij vreemden.
example_en: My little sister is shy around strangers.
alt: Een kind staat met de schouders naar voren en kijkt naar de grond.

scene: one child stands alone on a plain floor line facing the viewer, plain wall behind, with feet wide, chest out, chin raised and both fists on the hips. One brow is arched, the eyes look straight at the viewer, and the mouth is a wide grin with the tongue sticking out.
must: a child with fists on hips, chin up, grinning with tongue out.
avoid: a child twisting the shirt with head down (verlegen); an angry child with a frowning face (boos); a child waving hello (vriendelijk); a child jumping with joy (blij).
contrast: Pair with verlegen. The only difference is the child's pose: chin up, fists on hips and a cheeky grin here, head down and hands twisting the shirt there.
example_nl: De brutale jongen steekt zijn tong uit.
example_en: The cheeky boy sticks out his tongue.
alt: Een kind staat met de handen in de zij en steekt de tong uit.

scene: one adult man sits on the edge of a plain chair in a plain waiting room, whole figure from the front, a closed door behind. Both hands wring together in the lap, one foot taps with short tap marks under the toe, the brows tilt up and in, and the eyes glance toward the door.
must: wringing hands and a tapping foot on the chair edge.
avoid: a man sitting back with open hands and a soft smile (kalm); a person with clenched fists and neck lines (gespannen); a person leaning away from a threat (bang); a person crying (verdrietig); a person asleep in the chair (slaperig).
contrast: Pair with kalm. The only difference is the posture and the hands: on the chair edge with wringing hands and a tapping foot here, leaning back with open hands there.
example_nl: Ik ben zenuwachtig voor het examen.
example_en: I am nervous before the exam.
alt: Een man zit op de rand van een stoel, wrijft zijn handen over elkaar en tikt met één voet.

scene: one adult man sits well back on a plain chair in a plain waiting room, whole figure from the front, a closed door behind. His shoulders are low, both hands rest open on the thighs and both feet stand flat on the floor. The brows are level, the eyes open and steady, and the mouth shows a slight smile.
must: a man leaning back in the chair with open hands and steady open eyes.
avoid: a man on the chair edge wringing the hands (zenuwachtig); a person asleep with Z marks (slapen); a standing person with arms dangling loose (ontspannen); a person laughing out loud (blij).
contrast: Pair with zenuwachtig. The only difference is the posture and the hands: leaning back with open hands here, on the chair edge with wringing hands and a tapping foot there.
example_nl: Blijf kalm, het komt goed.
example_en: Stay calm, it will be fine.
alt: Een man zit achterover in een stoel met open handen op zijn knieën.

scene: one small plain house with a chimney and one tree beside it on a gentle hill line, front view, under a clear sky: a large sun with long rays in the upper corner, a few small birds, and short sharp shadows to the right of the house and tree. Not a single cloud or raindrop.
must: a big sun with long rays over a house and a tree with shadows.
avoid: a sky full of clouds hiding the sun (bewolkt); a rain cloud with drops (regenachtig); a moon and stars (donker); a thermometer (warm).
contrast: Pair with bewolkt. The only difference is the sky: a big sun with rays and no clouds here, a thick blanket of clouds and no sun there.
example_nl: Het is zondag en het is zonnig.
example_en: It is Sunday and it is sunny.
alt: De zon staat met lange stralen boven een huis en een boom.

scene: one small plain house with a chimney and one tree beside it on a gentle hill line, front view, under a sky filled with thick, overlapping rounded clouds that cover the whole upper area. No sun, no rays, no shadows beside the house or tree, and no raindrops.
must: a sky covered fully by thick clouds over a house and a tree.
avoid: a sun with rays and no clouds (zonnig); a single small cloud next to a sun (halfbewolkt); a cloud with raindrops (regenachtig); fog hiding the house (mistig).
contrast: Pair with zonnig. The only difference is the sky: a thick blanket of clouds and no sun here, a big sun with rays and no clouds there.
example_nl: Het is vandaag bewolkt en grijs.
example_en: It is cloudy and grey today.
alt: Dikke wolken bedekken de hele lucht boven een huis en een boom.

scene: one plain wooden stool on a flat floor line, side view, plain wall behind. All four legs are the same length and stand flat on the floor, and the seat is level. A full cup of water stands on the seat, its surface flat and still. No people, no other objects.
must: four equal legs flat on the floor under a level seat with a still cup.
avoid: a stool with one short leg and a tilted seat (wankel); a stool with one leg snapped off (kapot); a very tall stool (hoog); a heavy stone block instead of a stool (zwaar).
contrast: Pair with wankel. The only difference is the legs: four equal legs and a level seat here, one short leg and a tilted seat there.
example_nl: Deze tafel is oud, maar nog stevig.
example_en: This table is old, but still sturdy.
alt: Een houten kruk met vier gelijke poten; het kopje water op de zitting staat recht.

scene: the same plain wooden stool on a flat floor line, side view, plain wall behind. One back leg is shorter than the others, so the seat tilts and the stool rocks: two short curved motion marks sit beside the short leg. The full cup of water slides toward the low edge, its surface tilted.
must: one short leg, a tilted seat and rocking marks beside the leg.
avoid: a stool with four equal legs and a level seat (stevig); a stool lying on its side (kapot); a stool with a bent leg (krom); a stool on a sloping floor (steil).
contrast: Pair with stevig. The only difference is the legs: one short leg and a tilted seat here, four equal legs and a level seat there.
example_nl: Pas op, die ladder is wankel.
example_en: Careful, that ladder is wobbly.
alt: Een houten kruk met één korte poot helt over; het kopje water schuift naar de rand.

scene: one man stands at a plain glass shop door, side view, and holds it wide open with one arm, his body turned toward a woman carrying two full shopping bags one step behind him. He smiles at her and nods; she walks through. Plain wall behind.
must: the man holding the door open for the woman behind him.
avoid: the man letting the door swing shut in front of the woman (onbeleefd); the man and woman laughing together (vrolijk); the man shouting with V-brows (boos); the man carrying her bags for her (behulpzaam).
contrast: Pair with onbeleefd. The only difference is the door: held open for the woman here, swinging shut in front of her there.
example_nl: Het kind zegt beleefd dank je wel.
example_en: The child politely says thank you.
alt: Een man houdt de glazen deur open voor een vrouw met twee volle tassen.

scene: one man walks through a plain glass shop door, side view, without looking back. The door swings shut behind him, two short swing marks at its edge, right in front of a woman carrying two full shopping bags one step behind him. She stops short, eyebrows raised, mouth open. Plain wall behind.
must: the door swinging shut in front of the woman while the man walks on.
avoid: the man holding the door open for the woman (beleefd); the man shouting with V-brows (boos); the man running with long strides (haastig); the woman crying with tears (verdrietig).
contrast: Pair with beleefd. The only difference is the door: swinging shut in front of the woman here, held open for her there.
example_nl: Het is onbeleefd om niet te groeten.
example_en: It is rude not to say hello.
alt: Een man loopt door de glazen deur, die vlak voor een vrouw met twee volle tassen dichtvalt.

scene: one sheet of notepaper lying flat on a plain table, seen from straight above, a pen beside it. Five rows of short greeked strokes, no letters or digits, run in straight even lines with equal gaps and a neat margin on the left. The paper is flat and unfolded.
must: five straight, evenly spaced rows of strokes with a neat left margin.
avoid: rows sloping into each other with ink blots (slordig); a tidy stack of papers (netjes); a blank sheet (leeg); a crumpled sheet (gekreukt); a torn sheet (kapot).
contrast: Pair with slordig. The only difference is the strokes: straight even rows here, sloping crowded rows with blots there.
example_nl: Hij vult het formulier zorgvuldig in.
example_en: He fills in the form carefully.
alt: Een briefje op tafel met vijf rechte, gelijke regels streepjes en een pen ernaast.

scene: the same sheet of notepaper lying flat on a plain table, seen from straight above, a pen beside it. Five rows of greeked strokes, no letters or digits, slope downhill, crowd into each other and run off the right edge; two ink blots and one crossed-out stroke sit among them.
must: sloping, crowded rows running off the edge, with two ink blots.
avoid: straight even rows with a neat margin (zorgvuldig); a crumpled sheet (gekreukt); a sheet with coffee stains only (vuil); papers spread over a desk (rommelig).
contrast: Pair with zorgvuldig. The only difference is the strokes: sloping crowded rows with blots here, straight even rows there.
example_nl: Je handschrift is erg slordig.
example_en: Your handwriting is very sloppy.
alt: Een briefje op tafel met scheve regels streepjes die in elkaar lopen, en twee inktvlekken.

scene: one woman sitting in a wide armchair with thick soft cushions and armrests, side view, whole figure, plain room, a small side table with a cup beside her. She leans back deep into the cushions, legs stretched out, hands resting on the armrests, eyes open, a soft smile.
must: the woman sunk back with her legs stretched out.
avoid: the woman perched on the edge of a hard chair rubbing her back (ongemakkelijk); a finger pressing into a soft cushion (zacht); the woman asleep with closed eyes (slaperig); the woman with loose shoulders on any chair (ontspannen); a huge armchair dwarfing her (groot).
contrast: Pair with ongemakkelijk. The only difference is how she sits: sunk back with legs stretched out in a soft armchair here, perched on the edge of a hard chair rubbing her back there.
example_nl: Deze schoenen zijn heel comfortabel.
example_en: These shoes are very comfortable.
alt: Een vrouw leunt diep achterover in een brede fauteuil met dikke kussens.

scene: the same woman sitting on a hard narrow wooden chair with a straight back, side view, whole figure, plain room, a small side table with a cup beside her. She perches on the front edge, back stiff, one hand rubbing her lower back, her mouth pulled to one side.
must: the woman perched on the front edge, rubbing her back.
avoid: the woman sunk back in a soft armchair (comfortabel); an empty hard wooden seat (hard); the woman holding her stomach (ziek); the woman with clenched fists and neck lines (gespannen); a chair with one short leg (wankel).
contrast: Pair with comfortabel. The only difference is how she sits: perched on the edge of a hard chair rubbing her back here, sunk back with legs stretched out in a soft armchair there.
example_nl: Ik slaap slecht in dit ongemakkelijke bed.
example_en: I sleep badly in this uncomfortable bed.
alt: Een vrouw zit op het randje van een harde, smalle houten stoel en wrijft over haar rug.

scene: one dog sits upright in a plain kitchen, side view, whole animal, tail curled around its front paws, ears up, mouth closed, looking ahead. One slipper lies untouched on the floor in front of its paws. Plain wall, no other objects.
must: the dog sitting upright beside an untouched slipper.
avoid: the dog shaking a torn slipper with scraps on the floor (stout); the dog lying asleep (slaperig); the dog showing its teeth (agressief); the dog cowering with its tail down (bang); a dog walking at heel on a slack lead (gehoorzaam).
contrast: Pair with stout. The only difference is the slipper: lying untouched in front of the sitting dog here, torn in the dog's mouth there.
example_nl: Onze hond is lief en braaf.
example_en: Our dog is sweet and well-behaved.
alt: Een hond zit rechtop in de keuken; de pantoffel voor zijn poten is nog heel.

scene: one dog stands in a plain kitchen, side view, whole animal, the slipper held in its mouth and shaken, a torn strip hanging from it and three small scraps on the floor. Tail high, front paws spread playfully. Plain wall, no other objects.
must: the dog shaking a torn slipper, scraps on the floor.
avoid: the dog sitting beside an untouched slipper (braaf); the dog baring its teeth and growling (agressief); the dog eating from a bowl (hongerig); the dog running with speed lines (snel).
contrast: Pair with braaf. The only difference is the slipper: torn in the dog's mouth here, lying untouched in front of the sitting dog there.
example_nl: Het stoute kind verstopt de sleutels.
example_en: The naughty child hides the keys.
alt: Een hond schudt een kapotte pantoffel heen en weer; er liggen stukjes op de vloer.

scene: one plain rectangular hall seen from the front, one long table in the middle, no people. Paper garlands hang in loops along the back wall, a bunch of balloons is tied to each table end, and the table carries a cloth, plates and a cake with candles. No banners, no letters.
must: garlands, balloons and a laid table with a cake.
avoid: the same hall with bare walls and an empty table (kaal); a crowd of dancing people (druk); a hall lit by candles only (donker); a child blowing out candles (blij).
contrast: Pair with kaal. The only difference is the decoration: garlands, balloons and a laid table here, bare walls and an empty table there.
example_nl: Het was een feestelijke avond met vrienden.
example_en: It was a festive evening with friends.
alt: Een zaal met slingers aan de muur, ballonnen bij de tafel en een taart met kaarsjes.

scene: the same plain rectangular hall seen from the front, one long table in the middle, no people. The walls are completely bare, and the table top is empty, without a cloth. No other furniture, no letters.
must: bare walls and an empty table without a cloth.
avoid: garlands, balloons and a laid table (feestelijk); a hall full of boxes (rommelig); a hall with broken windows (kapot); the same hall without the table (leeg).
contrast: Pair with feestelijk. The only difference is the decoration: bare walls and an empty table here, garlands, balloons and a laid table there.
example_nl: Zonder posters is de muur kaal.
example_en: Without posters the wall is bare.
alt: Een zaal met lege muren en een lege tafel zonder kleed.

scene: one man sitting at a plain table in a small room, front view, upper body, one window in the back wall. The window stands wide open and the curtain lifts inward, three short wavy air lines beside it. The man sits upright, chest raised, taking a deep breath through the nose, a light smile.
must: the open window with the lifting curtain and the man breathing in deeply.
avoid: the shut window and the man tugging at his collar (benauwd); the man shivering with arms wrapped round himself (koud); trees outside bent by a gale (winderig); the man yawning (slaperig).
contrast: Pair with benauwd. The only difference is the window and the breathing: open with a lifting curtain and a deep breath here, shut and misted with the man tugging at his collar there.
example_nl: 's Ochtends is de lucht lekker fris.
example_en: In the morning the air is nice and fresh.
alt: Een man aan tafel ademt diep in; achter hem waait het gordijn bij het open raam naar binnen.

scene: one man sitting at a plain table in a small room, front view, upper body, one window in the back wall. The window is shut tight, its pane misted over with short dashes, and the curtain hangs straight and still. The man hooks one finger in his collar and pulls it loose, cheeks puffed, breathing out. No sweat drops.
must: the shut misted window and the man tugging at his collar, cheeks puffed.
avoid: the open window and the man breathing in deeply (fris); the man fanning his face with sweat drops (warm); the man fanning his open mouth over a bowl of soup (pittig); the man blowing on a steaming cup (heet); the man clutching his chest in panic (bang).
contrast: Pair with fris. The only difference is the window and the breathing: shut and misted with the man tugging at his collar here, open with a lifting curtain and a deep breath there.
example_nl: Het is benauwd in de volle bus.
example_en: It is stuffy in the full bus.
alt: Een man trekt met één vinger zijn kraag los en blaast zijn wangen bol; het raam achter hem is dicht en beslagen.

scene: one woman standing last in a queue of three adults at a plain shop counter, side view, whole figure, a shopkeeper behind the counter, plain wall, nothing with writing. She stands upright in line, hands loosely clasped in front of her, face relaxed with a slight smile, gaze resting on the back of the person ahead.
must: the woman standing upright in line, hands loosely clasped in front.
avoid: the woman leaning out of the line with crossed arms (ongeduldig); the man seated with hands in his lap (kalm); the woman waiting alone at a bus stop (vroeg); the woman wringing her hands and tapping her foot (zenuwachtig); the woman yawning (slaperig).
contrast: Pair with ongeduldig. The only difference is the woman: standing upright in line with clasped hands here, leaning out of the line with crossed arms there.
example_nl: De verpleegkundige is altijd heel geduldig.
example_en: The nurse is always very patient.
alt: Een vrouw staat als laatste in de rij bij de toonbank, rechtop, met de handen losjes voor zich.

scene: the same woman last in the queue of three adults at the plain shop counter, side view, whole figure, a shopkeeper behind the counter, plain wall, nothing with writing. She leans sideways out of the line to look at the counter, arms crossed, lips pressed together, one heel raised.
must: the woman leaning out of the line with crossed arms to look at the counter.
avoid: the woman standing upright in line with clasped hands (geduldig); the woman wringing her hands and tapping her foot (zenuwachtig); the woman shouting with V-brows (boos); the woman running for the door (laat).
contrast: Pair with geduldig. The only difference is the woman: leaning out of the line with crossed arms here, standing upright in line with clasped hands there.
example_nl: Wees niet zo ongeduldig, we zijn er bijna.
example_en: Don't be so impatient, we are almost there.
alt: Een vrouw staat als laatste in de rij, armen over elkaar, en buigt opzij om naar de toonbank te kijken.

scene: one small stream between two grassy banks, side view at a slight angle, one bush on the far bank. Three small fish swim near the bottom, pebbles show on the stream bed, and a few smooth ripple lines mark the surface. Nothing floats on the water.
must: fish and pebbles showing through the water, nothing floating.
avoid: bottles, a can and a dead fish floating on the surface (vervuild); a muddy puddle on a path (vuil); a jar you can see through (doorzichtig); a stream frozen over (bevroren).
contrast: Pair with vervuild. The only difference is the water: fish and pebbles showing and nothing floating here, bottles, a can and a dead fish floating there.
example_nl: Dit kraanwater is zuiver en veilig.
example_en: This tap water is pure and safe.
alt: Een beekje tussen twee oevers; je ziet visjes en steentjes op de bodem.

scene: the same small stream between two grassy banks, side view at a slight angle, one bush on the far bank. Two plastic bottles, a crushed can and a carrier bag float on the surface, one fish floats belly-up, and an oily wavy line trails across the water. The stream bed cannot be seen.
must: bottles, a can and a belly-up fish floating on the water.
avoid: fish and pebbles showing, nothing floating (zuiver); a shirt with stains (vuil); a dead plant in a pot (dood); a rubbish bin with flies (vies).
contrast: Pair with zuiver. The only difference is the water: bottles, a can and a dead fish floating here, fish and pebbles showing and nothing floating there.
example_nl: De lucht in de stad is vervuild.
example_en: The air in the city is polluted.
alt: Een beekje tussen twee oevers; er drijven flessen, een blikje, een tas en een dode vis.

scene: one plain desk against a plain wall, front view at desk height, a chair pushed under it. The papers lie in one squared stack, the three pens stand upright in the mug, and the books with blank covers stand in a straight row against the wall. Free desk space shows between the things.
must: one squared stack of papers and the pens upright in the mug.
avoid: papers spread everywhere, pens and books scattered (rommelig); a bare empty desk (leeg); a wiped desk with sparkle marks (schoon); straight rows of handwriting (zorgvuldig).
contrast: Pair with rommelig. The only difference is how the things lie: squared and in rows here, spread and piled across the desk there.
example_nl: Haar bureau is altijd keurig opgeruimd.
example_en: Her desk is always neatly tidied.
alt: Een bureau met één nette stapel papier, pennen rechtop in een mok en boeken op een rij.

scene: the same plain desk against a plain wall, front view at desk height, a chair pushed under it. The papers are spread across the whole top and hang over the edge, the three pens lie scattered, the mug is pushed into a corner and the books with blank covers lie in a crooked pile. One sheet lies on the floor.
must: papers spread over the whole desk with one sheet on the floor.
avoid: papers in one squared stack and pens in the mug (keurig); a desk with a coffee stain and crumbs (vuil); a desk with a broken leg (kapot); sloping handwriting with ink blots (slordig).
contrast: Pair with keurig. The only difference is how the things lie: spread and piled across the desk here, squared and in rows there.
example_nl: Mijn kamer is altijd een beetje rommelig.
example_en: My room is always a bit messy.
alt: Een bureau vol losse papieren, verspreide pennen en een scheve stapel boeken; één vel ligt op de grond.

scene: one adult man in a plain T-shirt and trousers on a flat floor line, side view, whole figure, plain wall behind. He bends forward from the hips with straight legs, and his flat palms rest on the floor beside his toes. His back curves smoothly and his face is relaxed.
must: palms flat on the floor beside the toes with straight legs.
avoid: the man stuck halfway, fingertips at his knees, one hand on his lower back (stijf); the man jumping high (fit); the man lying on the floor (moe); the man bent over a walking stick (oud).
contrast: Pair with stijf. The only difference is the reach: palms flat on the floor here, fingertips stuck at the knees there.
example_nl: Een kat is heel soepel.
example_en: A cat is very supple.
alt: Een man buigt voorover met gestrekte benen en zet zijn handen plat naast zijn tenen.

scene: the same adult man in a plain T-shirt and trousers on a flat floor line, side view, whole figure, plain wall behind. He bends forward only halfway, his fingertips stuck just below his knees, one hand pressed to his lower back, his back straight as a board, his face screwed up.
must: fingertips stuck at the knees and one hand pressed to the lower back.
avoid: palms flat on the floor beside the toes (soepel); the man bent with age over a walking stick (oud); the man with clenched fists and neck lines (gespannen); the man holding his stomach (ziek).
contrast: Pair with soepel. The only difference is the reach: fingertips stuck at the knees here, palms flat on the floor there.
example_nl: Na de lange reis zijn mijn benen stijf.
example_en: After the long journey my legs are stiff.
alt: Een man buigt half voorover; zijn vingers komen tot net onder de knie en één hand drukt op zijn rug.

scene: one woman on a plain stool, front view, whole figure, plain wall and floor. Across her lap she plays a guitar with a deep rounded body and a round sound hole under the strings. No cable and no amplifier; three small curved sound lines rise from the sound hole.
must: the round sound hole in a deep guitar body, with no cable.
avoid: a flat solid guitar with a cable to an amplifier (elektrisch); a tiny ukulele (klein); the woman singing with a wide-open mouth (luid); a guitar with a snapped string (kapot).
contrast: Pair with elektrisch. The only difference is the guitar: a deep body with a sound hole and no cable here, a flat solid body with a cable to an amplifier there.
example_nl: Hij speelt akoestische muziek in het café.
example_en: He plays acoustic music in the café.
alt: Een vrouw speelt gitaar; in de bolle klankkast zit een rond gat en er hangt geen snoer aan.

scene: the same woman on a plain stool, front view, whole figure, plain wall and floor. Across her lap she plays a guitar with a flat, thin, solid body and no sound hole. A cable runs from the guitar to a plain box amplifier on the floor with blank knobs and no numerals; three sound lines come from the amplifier.
must: a cable from the flat guitar to an amplifier box on the floor.
avoid: a deep guitar with a round sound hole and no cable (akoestisch); a microphone on a stand (luid); a guitar with a snapped string (kapot); a lamp with a cord and rays (licht).
contrast: Pair with akoestisch. The only difference is the guitar: a flat solid body with a cable to an amplifier here, a deep body with a sound hole and no cable there.
example_nl: Wij hebben een elektrische fiets gekocht.
example_en: We bought an electric bike.
alt: Een vrouw speelt gitaar; een snoer loopt van de platte gitaar naar een versterker op de grond.

scene: one man at a plain table, front view, upper body, a plain bowl of soup with nothing floating in it, a spoon at his mouth, a salt shaker on the table. His face is flat and unimpressed, one eyebrow raised, and he reaches for the salt shaker with his free hand.
must: the unimpressed face and the free hand reaching for the salt.
avoid: chilli slices in the soup and the man fanning his mouth (pittig); a man frowning at an empty plate (ontevreden); the man pushing the bowl away with his tongue out (vies); steam rising off the bowl (heet); the man smiling and licking his lips (lekker).
contrast: Pair with pittig. The only difference is the soup and the face: plain soup and a hand reaching for salt here, chilli slices and a fanned, sweating mouth there.
example_nl: Zonder zout is het eten flauw.
example_en: Without salt the food is bland.
alt: Een man proeft zijn soep met een verveeld gezicht en pakt het zoutvaatje.

scene: the same man at a plain table, front view, upper body, a plain bowl of soup with three small chilli slices floating in it and a whole chilli on the rim, spoon in hand, salt shaker untouched. His eyes water, three sweat drops sit on his brow and he fans his open mouth with his free hand.
must: chilli slices in the soup and the man fanning his open mouth.
avoid: plain soup and a hand reaching for the salt (flauw); the man tugging at his collar by a shut window (benauwd); steam rising off the soup and the man blowing on the spoon (heet); the man puckering at a lemon (zuur); the man crying with sad brows (verdrietig).
contrast: Pair with flauw. The only difference is the soup and the face: chilli slices and a fanned, sweating mouth here, plain soup and a hand reaching for salt there.
example_nl: Ik eet graag pittig Indonesisch eten.
example_en: I like eating spicy Indonesian food.
alt: Een man wappert met zijn hand voor zijn open mond; in de soep drijven stukjes chilipeper.

scene: the same plain small plate on a plain table, seen from slightly above, a knife beside it. The short clear glass on the plate holds one raw egg: a level liquid surface with the round yolk floating in the clear white. Two empty shell halves lie on the plate beside the glass.
must: the round yolk floating in liquid white inside the clear glass, empty shells beside it.
avoid: an empty glass and two firm egg halves on the plate (gekookt); a fried egg in a pan (gebakken); a whole unbroken egg in its shell (heel); an egg smashed on the floor (kapot).
contrast: Pair with gekookt. The only difference is the egg: liquid with a floating yolk in the glass here, two firm halves on the plate beside an empty glass there.
example_nl: In sushi zit vaak rauwe vis.
example_en: Sushi often contains raw fish.
alt: In een glaasje op een bordje drijft een dooier in het doorzichtige eiwit; de lege schaalhelften liggen ernaast.

scene: the same plain small plate on a plain table, seen from slightly above, a knife beside it. The short clear glass on the plate stands empty. Beside it lie two neat halves of a peeled egg, cut side up: a firm ring of white around a solid round yolk, each half keeping its shape.
must: two firm egg halves with a solid round yolk beside the empty glass.
avoid: a yolk floating in liquid white in the glass (rauw); a steaming pan of water (heet); a whole egg in an egg cup (heel); an egg with a cracked shell (kapot).
contrast: Pair with rauw. The only difference is the egg: two firm halves on the plate beside an empty glass here, liquid with a floating yolk in the glass there.
example_nl: Ik eet elke ochtend een gekookt ei.
example_en: I eat a boiled egg every morning.
alt: Op een bordje naast een leeg glaasje liggen twee gepelde eihelften met stevig eiwit en een ronde dooier.

scene: one plain short-sleeved T-shirt laid flat on a plain table, seen from straight above, whole shirt. Seven straight lines of even width run across the front and the sleeves, evenly spaced from collar to hem and all parallel. No other marks, no logo, no letters.
must: evenly spaced straight lines across the whole shirt.
avoid: a grid of crossing lines (geruit); round dots spread over the shirt (gestippeld); a plain shirt without marks (effen); a shirt with crease lines (gekreukt).
contrast: Pair with geruit, gestippeld. The only difference is the pattern: parallel lines here, a grid of squares or round dots there.
example_nl: Hij draagt een gestreepte trui.
example_en: He is wearing a striped jumper.
alt: Een T-shirt op tafel met zeven rechte, evenwijdige lijnen van kraag tot zoom.

scene: the same plain short-sleeved T-shirt laid flat on a plain table, seen from straight above, whole shirt. Straight lines run both across and up and down the front and sleeves, crossing to form an even grid of squares from collar to hem. No other marks, no logo, no letters.
must: an even grid of crossing lines forming squares.
avoid: parallel lines in one direction only (gestreept); round dots spread over the shirt (gestippeld); a plain shirt without marks (effen); a shirt with crease lines (gekreukt).
contrast: Pair with gestreept, gestippeld. The only difference is the pattern: a grid of squares here, parallel lines or round dots there.
example_nl: Opa heeft een geruit overhemd aan.
example_en: Grandpa is wearing a checked shirt.
alt: Een T-shirt op tafel met lijnen die elkaar kruisen en kleine vierkantjes vormen.

scene: the same plain short-sleeved T-shirt laid flat on a plain table, seen from straight above, whole shirt. Small round dots of equal size are spread evenly over the front and sleeves in neat staggered rows, from collar to hem. No lines, no other marks, no logo, no letters.
must: small round dots spread evenly over the whole shirt.
avoid: parallel lines (gestreept); a grid of squares (geruit); a few dirty spots and stains (vuil); a plain shirt without marks (effen).
contrast: Pair with gestreept, geruit. The only difference is the pattern: round dots here, parallel lines or a grid of squares there.
example_nl: Ze draagt een gestippelde jurk.
example_en: She is wearing a polka-dot dress.
alt: Een T-shirt op tafel vol kleine ronde puntjes in nette rijen.
